# pi-ask

> Structured TUI interviews for the Pi coding agent. One decision at a time.

In the TUI, questions can wait in the background, be answered later, or expire to a fallback. Hosts with dialog UI but no custom TUI (RPC subagents, ACP clients) get sequential select/input cards; callers with no UI at all get `status: "unavailable"`. Do not invent filler options.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): install, commands, input/output contract
- [Skill](skills/ask-user/SKILL.md): when and how the agent should ask
- [Extension](src/index.ts): `ask_user` registration
- [Package manifest](package.json): `npm:@gagansd/pi-ask`
